mapper.select: SELECT seq, message, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, ref_type AS refType, ref_seq AS refSeq, member_seq AS memberSeq FROM notification WHERE seq = #{seq}

SELECT seq, message, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, ref_type AS refType, ref_seq AS refSeq, member_seq AS memberSeq FROM notification WHERE member_seq = #{memberSeq} order by created_at desc
select count(*) from notification where member_seq = #{memberSeq} and is_read = 'N'
